description: This file defines a PHP class perf_mysql that extends adodb_perf to provide performance monitoring and tuning functionalities specifically for MySQL databases. It includes SQL statements, performance metrics, and methods for analyzing and optimizing database performance.

classes.name: perf_mysql
classes.description: A class for MySQL specific performance monitoring and optimization, including methods for retrieving database statistics, explain plans, and performing table maintenance.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Generates an EXPLAIN plan for a given SELECT SQL query, optionally handling partial explanations.

methods.name: Tables
methods.description: Returns an HTML representation of the table status information from the database.

methods.name: GetReads
methods.description: Retrieves the number of read queries executed, based on the status variables.

methods.name: GetWrites
methods.description: Retrieves the number of write queries (inserts, updates, deletes) executed, based on the status variables.

methods.name: FindDBHitRatio
methods.description: Determines the cache hit ratio for the database based on table type (MyISAM or InnoDB).

methods.name: GetQHitRatio
methods.description: Calculates the query cache hit ratio based on MySQL status variables.

methods.name: GetInnoDBHitRatio
methods.description: Calculates the InnoDB buffer pool hit ratio using 'show innodb status' output.

methods.name: GetKeyHitRatio
methods.description: Calculates the index key read hit ratio.

methods.name: optimizeTable
methods.description: Performs optimization on a specified table, with different levels of thoroughness.
